verdict.rationale: Abacum's own materials say it brings spreadsheet data into its governed source of truth alongside ERP, CRM and HRIS data (abacum-docs-3). It also documents an Excel connector that pushes data into Abacum and pulls it back out (abacum-docs-14). These are one-line marketing claims, so how a spreadsheet is ingested and whether it is treated on par with native connectors is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit CSV/file upload support, documentation of spreadsheet sources being mapped and refreshed like native connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
